bodySections.p5: Prescription kidney medications force blood vessels open temporarily.
bodySections.p6: You take it, it works for a few hours, then wears off. Your kidney's filtration function gets no better. In fact, many studies suggest it may worsen over time because you're not addressing the root cause.
bodySections.p8: The endothelium is the inner lining of your blood vessels—including the tiny capillaries inside your kidney's filtering units, the glomeruli. When it's damaged (from age, diet, inflammation), blood flow to your kidneys deteriorates and protein starts leaking into your urine, which is what causes that foam you see in the toilet bowl. Capsaicin restores this tissue, improving kidney filtration permanently.
